name: Waves
description: WebGL2 background of flowing Perlin-noise lines that react to the mouse with a spring displacement and click ripples, with an animated intro reveal and optional dashed style.
contents: Absolutely positioned container with a single full-size WebGL canvas drawing parallel wavy lines
behavior: Lines drift continuously along a Perlin noise field
Moving the pointer pushes nearby lines, which spring back with damping controlled by bounce and returnDuration
Clicking or tapping emits ripples that travel outward (max 6 at once)
Lines near disturbed areas blend toward the accent color
Intro animation reveals lines from the center outward and grows the amplitude over about 2.2 seconds
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden
With prefers-reduced-motion, flow, intro, pointer push and ripples are disabled
editableByProps: Line, accent and background colors, opacity, edge fade, and a darkened ink mode for light backgrounds
Solid or dashed lines, spacing, width, rotation angle
Wave amplitude, scale, twist, speed and a seed for different patterns
Mouse push radius, strength, bounce and return time, click ripple on or off
Intro on or off, pause, pixel ratio

needsCodeEdit.change: Change ripple speed, size or strength
needsCodeEdit.where: RIPPLE_SPEED and RIPPLE_WIDTH constants and the ripple power formula in simulate

needsCodeEdit.change: Change line smoothness or vertex budget

needsCodeEdit.where: uPeriod uniform (spacing * 2.6) in render and the uStyle == 1 branch of the FRAGMENT shader

needsCodeEdit.change: Add a static fallback when WebGL2 is unavailable
needsCodeEdit.where: Early return after getContext at the start of the main useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2 with float RG32F textures, renders nothing if unavailable and has no fallback
Container is position absolute with inset 0, so the parent must be positioned and sized
Listens to pointer events on window, so interaction works even when other elements cover the canvas
The canvas is aria-hidden and decorative only
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling flow, intro and interaction
Heavy GPU load on large screens with small spacing, vertex count is capped at 1.6 million
Touch input triggers ripples on tap but no continuous push, usable on mobile but GPU heavy on low-end devices

options.useWhen: A clean, calm wave texture behind content

options.look: Dashed lines whose dashes move along the line, offset per line
